title: Personal Loans Rate Sheet: Base Rate Bands, Term Adjustments and APR Ceiling
content:
The Personal Loans rate sheet sets, for each grade, the band of 36-month base interest rates, the points a different term adds or takes off, and the highest APR Larkspur discloses. All figures are annual percentages.

## Rate sheet

| | Grade A | Grade B | Grade C | Grade D | Grade E | Grade F | Grade G |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 36-month base rate floor | 7.99 | 10.49 | 12.99 | 15.99 | 18.99 | 21.99 | 24.99 |
| 36-month base rate ceiling | 10.49 | 12.49 | 15.49 | 18.49 | 21.49 | 24.49 | 28.49 |
| Term adjustment, 24 months (points) | -0.50 | -0.50 | -0.25 | -0.25 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Term adjustment, 48 months (points) | 0.75 | 0.75 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.25 | not offered | not offered |
| Term adjustment, 60 months (points) | 1.25 | 1.50 | 1.75 | 2.00 | not offered | not offered | not offered |
| Term adjustment, 72 months (points) | 1.75 | 2.00 | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered |
| Highest APR disclosed | 35.99 | 35.99 | 35.99 | 35.99 | 35.99 | 35.99 | 35.99 |

## Definitions

- **Base rate floor**: lowest 36-month base interest rate in the grade, percent (before term adjustment and discounts).
- **Base rate ceiling**: highest 36-month base interest rate in the grade, percent.
- **24-month term adjustment**: percentage points added to (negative: subtracted from) the 36-month base rate for a 24-month term.
- **48-, 60- and 72-month term adjustments**: percentage points added to the 36-month base rate for that term; "not offered" when unavailable.
- **Highest APR disclosed**: highest APR Larkspur will disclose on any loan (base rate and origination fee combined), percent; offers that would exceed it are re-priced to the grade's rate floor or declined.

## Reading the adjustments

A 36-month term takes no adjustment. A negative 24-month figure takes points off the 36-month rate: in Grades A and B a 24-month loan is half a point below its 36-month rate, in Grades C and D a quarter point below, and in Grades E, F and G the same. A positive figure adds points: a Grade D 60-month loan is 2.00 points above its 36-month rate. "Not offered" marks a term the grade does not lend for.
